name: fullstack-feature
title: Fullstack Feature Delivery
description: End-to-end workflow for changes spanning UI, API, data, tests, and cross-agent review.

planner.description: Owns requirements, architecture, sequencing, and explicit stop points.

executor.description: Implements frontend, backend, tests, and docs within the approved scope.

reviewer.description: Validates behavior, regressions, contracts, and release readiness.

observer.description: Tracks cross-agent status, handoffs, and unresolved risk.

steps.task: Clarify the end-to-end feature. Output JSON with user workflow, API/data contract, non-goals, acceptance criteria, risks, and stop conditions.
Inspect frontend, backend, data, tests, docs, and deployment assumptions. Output JSON with impacted modules, ownership boundaries, and verification matrix.
Produce a concise design note covering UI states, API contract, persistence, error handling, observability, and migration or compatibility concerns.
Create or update shared tasks for implementation, review, and verification. Record dependencies, owners, and expected artifacts.
Implement the fullstack change in small commits or handoff-ready increments. Keep unrelated refactors out of scope.
Run focused frontend, backend, integration, and browser/API checks. Fix failures and output structured results with residual risks.
Review diff, contracts, UI behavior, tests, docs, and handoff notes. Reply PASS or blockers only.
